root_cause: The Start button still depended on app.js being successfully imported and initialized. If any ES-module import/startup error occurs, no handler inside app.js can exist.
fix: Added critical-ui.js as a classic script loaded before app.js.
It owns the Start button in capture phase and therefore works independently of the app module lifecycle.
When app.js is healthy it calls the full startNewTrip reset through window.reisslimStartNewTrip exactly once.
If app.js is unavailable it still opens plannerView instead of leaving a dead button.
The delegated listener survives replacement of the button DOM node.
browser_test_note: Headless Chromium exercised the actual ReisSlim dashboard/planner DOM. External localhost navigation is blocked in this environment, so the actual index HTML was injected with page.set_content.
